stories.title: Dart to have surgery, miss regular season; Harbaugh won't rule out playoffs
stories.summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will undergo surgery on his left knee and sit out the rest of the regular season, though coach John Harbaugh didn't rule out the possibility Dart could return if New York makes the playoffs.

stories.title: Rice bests Boone's belief by slugging homers 40, 41
stories.summary: Yankees manager Aaron Boone predicted during spring training that Ben Rice would finish with 39 home runs this season. Rice is two-up after hitting Nos. 40 and 41 in a 9-2 victory over the Rays, tying for the AL home run lead.

stories.title: Longtime Lakers PA announcer Tanter dies at 76
stories.summary: Lawrence Tanter had manned the microphone in L.A. since the "Showtime" days until his retirement in June following a stroke.

stories.title: Guerrero doubles down on contract comments: 'What I said is the way I feel'
stories.summary: Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is standing by comments he made during a recent interview regarding his performance this season after signing a 14-year, $500 million contract last year.

stories.title: Seahawks coach apologizes to Payton for comments: 'Lesson learned'
stories.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday he called Broncos coach Sean Payton and apologized for comments he made in a published video that went viral Tuesday.
